# Kring (กริ๊ง!) Bangkok

> Kring (กริ๊ง!) is a Bangkok people app. Locals and visitors post short clips of real Bangkok spots, make new friends who are into the same things, at partner cafés and other public places. Thai or English, with built-in translation. Free to use.

- Website: https://kringapp.com/ (English: https://kringapp.com/en/ · Thai: https://kringapp.com/th/)
- App (web, Android and iPhone browsers): https://kringapp.com/app/
- Areas: all of Bangkok, most active in Ari, Siam, Thonglor, Ekkamai and Silom.
- Kring Locals: people who post clips of their Bangkok; the top 8 of each week win prizes (฿1,500 / 900 / 600 / 500 / 400 / 250 / 150 / 100).
- Safety: everything happens in public places, never private addresses.
